children: Azuki Elementals is our hype-piece for Los Angeles based Web3 anime brand Azuki. This film showcases the Azuki Elementals, a collection of characters within the four domains of the Garden: Earth, Fire, Lightning and Water.

Our FX heavy, anime inspired hype piece showcases the elemental capabilities of Azuki's season 2 NFTs. We aimed to go old school with our approach to character colors, drawing inspiration from cinematic masterpieces like Akira and beloved Ghibli classics. Our goal was to create character palettes that seamlessly blended with their respective environments.

attrs.class: p3 module-team fw470 slash-light gutters module-proxy

children: A sort of Avatar meet Naruto, Azuki tasked us with showcasing characters with elemental powers haling from different cities; water, fire, earth and lightning. I gave each character a mini back story which informed their movement on screen. Water girl for example is playful, clumsy but arguably the most powerful of the 4. The limitation of this production brought out some beautiful results from clean up to background art style which I’m really proud of. Ive spent years working and never quite seeing what “my style” is and this projects feels like the first step in me potentially finding my visual voice.
